segments.sn29.11-20:1.1: 352-361. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn29.11-20:1.2: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī”ti?
segments.sn29.11-20:2.1: “Idha, bhikkhu, ekacco kāyena dvayakārī hoti, vācāya dvayakārī, manasā dvayakārī.
segments.sn29.11-20:2.5: ‘aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan’ti.
segments.sn29.11-20:2.7: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.sn29.11-20:2.8: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu … pe … upapajjatīti … pe … so pānaṃ deti … pe … vatthaṃ deti … pe … yānaṃ deti … pe … mālaṃ deti … pe … gandhaṃ deti … pe … vilepanaṃ deti … pe … seyyaṃ deti … pe … āvasathaṃ deti … pe … padīpeyyaṃ deti.
segments.sn29.11-20:2.18: So kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjati.
segments.sn29.11-20:2.19: Ayaṃ kho, bhikkhu, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo, yena midhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā aṇḍajānaṃ nāgānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī”ti.
